# BoxHero User Guide

> BoxHero is an inventory management service. This guide covers the product itself, frequently
> asked questions, release notes, and developer docs for the BoxHero API and webhooks.

Every page is also available as Markdown at the same address with a `.md` suffix, and the whole
guide is at https://www.boxhero.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

## Developers

- [Developers](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers.md): Connect your own systems to BoxHero with the BoxHero API and webhooks.

### BoxHero API

- [Quickstart](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/quickstart.md): Issue an API token and make your first request to the BoxHero API.
- [Authentication](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/authentication.md): Authenticate BoxHero API requests with a Bearer token and send them to the versioned base URL.
- [Pagination](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/pagination.md): Walk through long lists in the BoxHero API with cursor-based pagination.
- [Errors](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/errors.md): Understand the error envelope the BoxHero API returns and how to handle errors in your code.
- [Rate limiting](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/rate-limiting.md): How the BoxHero API limits request rates per team and how to back off and retry.
- [API reference](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference.md): The BoxHero API lets you read and write inventory data — items, locations, partners, transactions, and orders — for a single BoxHero team.
  - [Items](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items.md): Items — the smallest unit of inventory tracked by BoxHero.
    - [List items](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/list-items.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of items in the team.
    - [Create an item](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/create-item.md): Creates a new item in the team.
    - [Get an item](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/get-item.md): Returns a single item by id.
    - [Update an item](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/update-item.md): Partially updates an item.
    - [Delete an item](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/delete-item.md): Deletes an item.
    - [Get an item by SKU](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/get-item-by-sku.md): Looks up an item by SKU (case-insensitive) and returns the same payload as GET /items/{item_id}.
    - [Update an item by SKU](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/update-item-by-sku.md): Looks up an item by SKU (case-insensitive) and applies the same partial update as PUT /items/{item_id}.
    - [Delete an item by SKU](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/items/delete-item-by-sku.md): Looks up an item by SKU (case-insensitive) and deletes it.
  - [Item attributes](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs.md): Custom attribute specs attached to items (text, date, number, barcode).
    - [List attribute specs](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs/list-item-attrs.md): Lists every custom attribute spec defined for the team, sorted by rank ascending.
    - [Create an attribute spec](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs/create-item-attr.md): Creates a new custom attribute spec for the team.
    - [Get an attribute spec](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs/get-item-attr.md): Returns a single custom attribute spec by id.
    - [Rename an attribute spec](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs/rename-item-attr.md): Renames an attribute spec.
    - [Delete an attribute spec](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs/delete-item-attr.md): Deletes an attribute spec.
    - [Reorder attribute specs](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/item-attrs/reorder-item-attrs.md): Updates the rank of one or more attribute specs in a single call.
  - [Locations](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/locations.md): Locations where inventory is stored.
    - [List locations](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/locations/list-locations.md): Returns every active location in the team, with each location's rolled-up quantity.
    - [Create a location](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/locations/create-location.md): Creates a new location.
    - [Get a location](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/locations/get-location.md): Returns a single location by id.
    - [Update a location](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/locations/update-location.md): Updates a location's name and/or memo.
    - [Delete a location](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/locations/delete-location.md): Deletes a location, except the team's last remaining location (403).
  - [Members](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/members.md): Team members.
    - [List team members](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/members/list-members.md): Lists every active member of the team linked to the current API token.
    - [Get a team member](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/members/get-member.md): Returns a single team member by id.
  - [Team](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/teams.md): Information about the team linked to the current API token.
    - [Get the linked team](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/teams/get-linked-team.md): Returns metadata for the team that owns the current API token (id, name, currency, mode).
  - [Partners](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/partners.md): Business partners — suppliers and customers used in Stock In and Stock Out transactions.
    - [List partners](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/partners/list-partners.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of partners (suppliers and customers).
    - [Create a partner](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/partners/create-partner.md): Creates a new partner.
    - [Get a partner](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/partners/get-partner.md): Returns a single partner by id.
    - [Update a partner](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/partners/update-partner.md): Updates an existing partner's name, contact details, and memo.
    - [Delete a partner](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/partners/delete-partner.md): Deletes a partner.
  - [Transactions](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/transactions.md): Inventory transactions: Stock In, Stock Out, Move Stock, and Adjust Stock.
    - [List transactions](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/transactions/list-transactions.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of inventory transactions (Stock In, Stock Out, Move Stock, Adjust Stock) without per-item detail.
    - [Create a transaction](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/transactions/create-transaction.md): Records a new inventory transaction.
    - [Get a transaction](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/transactions/get-transaction.md): Returns a single transaction with its full line items.
    - [Update a transaction](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/transactions/update-transaction.md): Partially updates an existing transaction.
    - [Delete a transaction](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/transactions/delete-transaction.md): Soft-deletes a transaction.
  - [Bundles](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles.md): Bundles — fixed groups of existing items, each with a set quantity, that can be sold or purchased together as a single line item.
    - [List bundles](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/list-bundles.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of active bundles.
    - [Create a bundle](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/create-bundle.md): Creates a bundle from existing items.
    - [Get a bundle](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/get-bundle.md): Returns a single active bundle with its component items.
    - [Update a bundle](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/update-bundle.md): Partially updates a bundle.
    - [Delete a bundle](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/delete-bundle.md): Soft-deletes a bundle.
    - [Get a bundle by SKU](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/get-bundle-by-sku.md): Looks up a bundle by SKU (case-sensitive) and returns the same payload as GET /bundles/{bundle_id}.
    - [Update a bundle by SKU](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/update-bundle-by-sku.md): Looks up a bundle by SKU (case-sensitive) and applies the same partial update as PUT /bundles/{bundle_id}.
    - [Delete a bundle by SKU](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/bundles/delete-bundle-by-sku.md): Looks up a bundle by SKU (case-sensitive) and soft-deletes it.
  - [Purchase orders](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders.md): Purchase orders for incoming inventory.
    - [List purchase orders](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/list-purchase-orders.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of active purchase orders.
    - [Create a purchase order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/create-purchase-order.md): Creates a purchase order.
    - [Get a purchase order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/get-purchase-order.md): Returns a purchase order by id, with lines, per-item fulfillment progress, and linked stock transactions.
    - [Update a purchase order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/update-purchase-order.md): Partially updates a purchase order.
    - [Delete a purchase order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/delete-purchase-order.md): Deletes a purchase order: the order itself is soft-deleted (no longer returned), but its line items and costs are permanently removed.
    - [Update purchase order status](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/update-purchase-order-status.md): Sets the purchase order status directly.
    - [Receive purchase order quantities](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/create-purchase-order-transaction.md): Creates a partial fulfillment transaction for a purchase order.
    - [Receive all remaining purchase order quantities](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/complete-purchase-order-transactions.md): Creates fulfillment transactions for every remaining purchase order quantity and marks the order done.
    - [Get a purchase order by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/get-purchase-order-by-number.md): Looks up a purchase order by order number and returns the same payload as the by-id endpoint.
    - [Update a purchase order by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/update-purchase-order-by-number.md): Looks up a purchase order by order number and applies the same partial update as the by-id endpoint.
    - [Delete a purchase order by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/delete-purchase-order-by-number.md): Looks up a purchase order by order number and deletes it: the order itself is soft-deleted (no longer returned), but its line items and costs are permanently removed.
    - [Update purchase order status by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/update-purchase-order-status-by-number.md): Looks up a purchase order by order number and updates its status.
    - [Create purchase order fulfillment transaction by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/create-purchase-order-transaction-by-number.md): Looks up a purchase order by order number and creates a partial fulfillment transaction.
    - [Complete all remaining purchase order fulfillment by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/purchase-orders/complete-purchase-order-transactions-by-number.md): Looks up a purchase order by order number and fulfills every remaining quantity, marking the order done.
  - [Sales orders](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders.md): Sales orders for outgoing inventory.
    - [List sales orders](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/list-sales-orders.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of active sales orders.
    - [Create a sales order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/create-sales-order.md): Creates a sales order.
    - [Get a sales order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/get-sales-order.md): Returns a sales order by id, with lines, sales-return totals, per-item fulfillment progress, and linked stock transactions.
    - [Update a sales order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/update-sales-order.md): Partially updates a sales order.
    - [Delete a sales order](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/delete-sales-order.md): Deletes a sales order: the order itself is soft-deleted (no longer returned), but its line items and costs are permanently removed.
    - [Update sales order status](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/update-sales-order-status.md): Sets the sales order status directly.
    - [Ship sales order quantities](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/create-sales-order-transaction.md): Creates a partial fulfillment transaction for a sales order.
    - [Ship all remaining sales order quantities](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/complete-sales-order-transactions.md): Creates fulfillment transactions for every remaining sales order quantity and marks the order done.
    - [Get a sales order by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/get-sales-order-by-number.md): Looks up a sales order by order number and returns the same payload as the by-id endpoint.
    - [Update a sales order by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/update-sales-order-by-number.md): Looks up a sales order by order number and applies the same partial update as the by-id endpoint.
    - [Delete a sales order by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/delete-sales-order-by-number.md): Looks up a sales order by order number and deletes it: the order itself is soft-deleted (no longer returned), but its line items and costs are permanently removed.
    - [Update sales order status by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/update-sales-order-status-by-number.md): Looks up a sales order by order number and updates its status.
    - [Create sales order fulfillment transaction by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/create-sales-order-transaction-by-number.md): Looks up a sales order by order number and creates a partial fulfillment transaction.
    - [Complete all remaining sales order fulfillment by order number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/sales-orders/complete-sales-order-transactions-by-number.md): Looks up a sales order by order number and fulfills every remaining quantity, marking the order done.
  - [Returns](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns.md): Sales returns anchored to sales orders.
    - [List sales returns](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/list-returns.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of active sales returns.
    - [Create a sales return](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/create-return.md): Creates a sales return for a sales order.
    - [Get a sales return](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/get-return.md): Returns a sales return by id, with source order reference, lines, per-item receiving progress, and linked stock transactions.
    - [Update a sales return](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/update-return.md): Partially updates a sales return.
    - [Delete a sales return](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/delete-return.md): Deletes a sales return: the return itself is soft-deleted (no longer returned), but its line items are permanently removed.
    - [Receive returned quantities](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/create-return-transaction.md): Creates a partial receiving transaction for a sales return.
    - [Receive all remaining returned quantities](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/complete-return-transactions.md): Creates receiving transactions for every remaining returned quantity and marks the return done.
    - [Get a sales return by return number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/get-return-by-number.md): Looks up a sales return by return number and returns the same payload as GET /returns/{return_id}.
    - [Update a sales return by return number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/update-return-by-number.md): Looks up a sales return by return number and applies the same partial update as PUT /returns/{return_id}.
    - [Delete a sales return by return number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/delete-return-by-number.md): Looks up a sales return by return number and deletes it: the return itself is soft-deleted (no longer returned), but its line items are permanently removed.
    - [Receive returned quantities by return number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/create-return-transaction-by-number.md): Looks up a sales return by return number and creates a partial receiving transaction.
    - [Receive all remaining returned quantities by return number](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/returns/complete-return-transactions-by-number.md): Looks up a sales return by return number and creates receiving transactions for every remaining returned quantity, marking the return done.
  - [Price lists](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/price-lists.md): Price lists — saved unit prices for items and bundles, each tied to purchase or sales orders.
    - [List price lists](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/price-lists/list-price-lists.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of price lists (id ascending), without their line items.
    - [Create a price list](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/price-lists/create-price-list.md): Creates a price list with at least one line item.
    - [Get a price list](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/price-lists/get-price-list.md): Returns a single price list by id, including its line items.
    - [Update a price list](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/price-lists/update-price-list.md): Updates a price list.
    - [Delete a price list](https://www.boxhero.io/docs/developers/api/reference/price-lists/delete-price-list.md): Soft-deletes a price list.

### Webhooks
